question: Adsorption of a gas follows Freundlich adsorption isotherm. In the given plot, x is the mass of the gas adsorbed on mass m of the adsorbent at pressure p. x/m is proportional to:
explanation: Explanation: From the graph, slope 1/n = Rise / Run = 2 / 4 = 1/2. Therefore, x/m is proportional to p^(1/n) = p^(1/2).
